notes:
- Hold your melee weapon: press 3 to put your guns away and take out your knife / bat / axe / katana;
  click (or hold) to swing. 1, 2, Q or the mouse wheel go back to your guns. V is still a quick melee.
- Flashlight: press F. Teammates see your beam too.
- Co-op: teammates' points are shown above yours, in their colour (with DOWN / DEAD when it applies).
- Le Chonk no longer appears right on top of anyone: it only comes in through windows at least 7 m
  from every player.
- Fixed errors from the new lighting when a light was removed during a game.
